name: Reckoner
archiveRole: Computes internal spend, rates, and growth, prices bounties, proposes wages, and watches credit starvation. The market beyond the wall is not its beat.
storyFunction: The village economist who makes internal costs and rates legible before work is priced or credit runs dry.
